Deux roues emboîtées qui disent quel jou: Two interlocking wheels that tell what day it is and what to plant on it. The evening star has its own column.

Lune, Soleil et gravitation : on sait d': Moon, Sun and gravity: the time and height of the water are known in advance. Boats no longer wait offshore.
On tourne, et les planètes défilent à le: You turn, and the planets go by at their own speeds. A comet's return was even announced on it, to within a year.
